description: As stablenet-testnet, plus one funded account bound to the label payer. The key is read as raw hex from the file GSTABLE_TESTNET_KEY_FILE points at, outside the repository. A keystore JSON is refused because a declaration has nowhere to put a password — chainbench keyring export writes out the hex it holds. Neither the address nor the key appears in a case; only the variable name does. A read-only case needs no keyFile and uses stablenet-testnet instead. A missing file means the variable was forgotten, and the run stops there.
